description: No clean concept found. Strongest firing is a left-centre opening shape: my two stones stacked in column 2 (bottom two cells) with the cell above empty, their stones beside them at the bottom of columns 3 and 4, and column 4 at most one stone high. An opponent stone placed directly on top of my column-2 stack switches it off. Firing positions mostly have column 4 nearly empty, but that alone does not predict firing.
effect: Small: when strongly active it raises column 2 and lowers column 3 by about 7-10 points; forcing it high elsewhere lowers column 3 by about 5 points.
notes: 7 score calls; all rules AUROC 0.51-0.58. Best F1 0.130 (p1: column 4 height<=1, my stone at (1,2), column 2 height 2; P .17 R .10). Tried: column-4-low with my column-3 stones (0.106), open horizontal windows (0.046), column 3 minus column 4 height gap (0.084, recall .46), my (r,2)-(r,3) pair next to empty (r,4) (0.089), combined template (0.104). Minimal pairs show very nonadditive, position-specific responses (mirror images do not fire; single-stone edits swing it 0 to 7). Likely a mixture or random direction.
